# Livemed Academy

> Where AI meets medicine. A US-based medical education platform for International Medical Graduates offering virtual clinical rotations, USMLE prep, and residency readiness training.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Livemed Academy — AI-driven training for IMGs.
- [Programs](/programs): Pre-clinical, clinical, residency prep, and CME programs.
- [Rotations](/rotations): Virtual US clinical rotations across core specialties.
- [Institutions](/institutions): Partnerships for medical schools and hospitals.
- [About](/about): Mission, faculty, and JCo accreditation.
- [Case Studies](/case-studies): Clinical case walkthroughs.
- [Apply](/apply): Apply for admission to Livemed Academy.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the Livemed team.
